senses.gloss: f. (רָגַשׁ, Hif.) sensation, perception, sensuous affection.
units: <cite ref="Niddah 43a:35">Nidd. 43ᵃ</cite> <he>נעקרה בה׳</he> he felt the effusion coming, <he>ויצתה שלא בה׳</he> but the discharge was not perceived.
<cite ref="Niddah 57b:22">Ib. 57ᵇ</cite> <he>הַרְגָּשַׁת מי וכ׳</he> the sensation of discharging urin; a. fr.
Yalk. Jud. 42 לכל ה׳ וה׳ to every sense.—Pl. הַרְגָּשׁוֹת senses.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 14:4">Num. R. s. 14</cite> <he>כנגד חמש ה׳ וחמש מורגשות</he> corresponding to the five senses and the five perceptions.
